8/23/04; Anaheim, CA; Arrowhead Pond
8/23/04 – featured Method Man in attendance for the event; included a surprise appearance from the Rock in which he hosted an in-ring segment with the remaining Diva contestants, eventually winning a fight against Jonathan Coachman and La Resistance, with Tajiri and Rhyno helping out; featured Triple H calling Randy Orton out and demanding that he hand him the world title belt; Orton responded by spitting in Triple H’s face, hitting him in the head with the championship belt, and escaping through the crowd as Evolution tried to get at him; included a closing segment in which Kane and Lita wed, due to contractual obligations; the segment featured appearances from Eric Bischoff, Trish Stratus, and Matt Hardy – as Hardy attempted to attack Kane and stop the wedding; Kane knocked Hardy off the stage, dragged Lita back inside the ring, and finsihed the vows to end the broadcast:
Chris Jericho defeated WWF IC Champion Edge via disqualification at 15:47 after the champion accidentally crotched Jericho across the top rope; after the bell, Edge hit the spear on his opponent; the champion originally won the match earlier but the match was restarted due to Jericho’s foot being on the ring ropes
William Regal (w/ Eugene) pinned Ric Flair (w/ Batista) at 12:10 when, as both men prepared to hit the other with brass knuckles, Regal knocked Flair out with his foreign object while Eugene and Batista fought on the floor

8/30/04; San Francisco, CA; Cow Palace
Jonathan Coachman, WWE Raw Tag Team Champions Rob Conway & Sylvian Grenier defeated Rhyno & Tajiri in a handicap match at 4:55
Batista defeated William Regal at 2:55
Kane defeated Pat, Nat, Rat, & Fat Hardy at the 19-second mark
Chris Benoit defeated Ric Flair via disqualification at 5:54 when Batista interfered
Victoria & Nidia defeated WWE Women’s Champion Trish Stratus & Gail Kim at 3:47
Eugene pinned Triple H in a No DQ match at 10:49 after Randy Orton interfered

9/6/04; Wichita Falls, TX; Kay Yeager Coliseum
9/6/04 – included the announcement that Edge had been stripped of the WWE IC Title due to injury and that Chris Jericho would face Christian for the vacant title at Unforgiven in a ladder match:
